first_failure.error: relinquished Generator did not release its expected CUDA storage
first_failure.mechanism: Module.to_empty(meta) replaced module Parameter objects, while DeepSpeed optimizer aliases retained the original CUDA Parameters.

bounded_recovery.evidence: A mini CUDA probe verified torch.utils.swap_tensors changes both module and optimizer aliases to meta and releases CUDA allocation.
bounded_recovery.scope: Only obsolete ranks 2-7 after final Step10-A Generator use.

cascade: Peer NCCL/TCPStore failures followed the release assertion and are not independent root causes.
